scenario.summary: Signed in: clicks the spreadsheet template link on the Paste Multiple tab and checks the template file is downloaded (then deletes it).
steps: Open the webstore and sign in
Quick Order, Add Multiple Items, Paste Multiple
Verify the downloaded file quickOrderTemplateName exists; delete it
stateChanges: Downloads and deletes a local file
evidence: Reads no record value; the template file name is fixed UI output (expected-output).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): this method signs in itself with loginPage.successfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/quickOrderRetailUserTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B190/C190). An account lease (useExisting) is held by the method that declares it and released when that method ends, so every signing-in method declares its own need user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: its username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting), as the Selenium pilot entries T01-T04. Username/password are credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its own sheet. The scanner recorded the credential values only on LoginWithAUserAccount, MaximumAndMinimumQuantityValidations and AddMultipleProductsToCart; on the other methods the same two cells (same location, kind and masking) are declared from the test source (every method calls successfullLogin with them).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
